publications.title: Man sentenced over £154m fake takeover bid targeting UK-listed company
publications.summary: Christopher Woolcott has today been given a 2-year prison sentence, suspended for 2 years, after staging a £154m fake takeover bid for Touchstone Exploration Inc. He was also ordered to complete 200 hours of unpaid work and to pay costs of £4,627.73.Mr Woolcott built a sizeable stake in Touchstone, an oil and gas listed company. He then launched a bogus bid to drive up its share price. To give the bid credibility, Mr Woolcott invented several identities, forged takeover documents using Chat GPT and met Touchstone’s chief executive at a central London hotel under a false name. publications.title: FINMA publishes partially revised FINMA Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance
publications.summary: The Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority FINMA has partially revised the FINMA Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance. It also recognised the revised agreement on the Swiss banks’ code of conduct with regard to the exercise of due diligence and the revised regulations of the SRO-SVV as minimum standards. Finally, FINMA has published guidance explaining FINMA Circular 2011/1 “Acting as a financial intermediary under the AMLA”.

publications.title: EU seeks nominations for stakeholder group on tokenisation standards in finance
publications.summary: EU seeks nominations for stakeholder group on tokenisation standards in finance 09 November 2026 Digital Finance and Innovation The European Central Bank (ECB), together with the European Commission and the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), is calling upon wholesale financial industry stakeholders to express their interest in joining the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG). The group will bring together industry stakeholders to develop common standards for an interconnected tokenised financial ecosystem. The group aims to establish a framework for monitoring compliance with the agreed standards and may formulate recommendations for EU authorities on how to incentivise compliance with those standards.
